name: security_scan
title: Security Scan
description: 在沙盒检查压缩包、脚本和可疑文件风险。
input_contract: Potentially unsafe files must be imported and inspected inside the sandbox, never executed directly as trusted code.
output_contract: Return risk findings, file indicators, and safe next steps without exposing users to executable payloads.
runtime_policy: Inspect files in sandbox only. Do not execute untrusted scripts unless explicitly isolated and required for analysis.
